name: run_curve
text: A person runs steadily around a broad circular path turning left, keeping a running gait throughout and returning to the initial position and facing direction.

review.notes_zh: 以跑步完整步态约束半径4米的左转圆形路径，6个步态周期后回到起点和原朝向；根路径对目标圆半径最大偏差4.84厘米。并非直跑改名；接入时需要8米直径空地。
